newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 124 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 124 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 124 contracts versus 940 contracts overnight Sunday.
There were 11 wheat, corn was not available, 101 soybean, two soymeal, soyoil was not available, two oat and 10 rough rice contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent lower, corn was fractionally mixed and soybeans were one cent lower to 1/2 cent higher.
